item.title: Sea Cloud Spirit has appeared in Exsus Travel's Winter Sun Edit this week, and within JLT we think she deserves a place on agents' radar ahead of winter 2026/27.
item.description:
Sea Cloud Spirit has appeared in Exsus Travel's Winter Sun Edit this week, and within JLT we think she deserves a place on agents' radar ahead of winter 2026/27.
Built new in 2021 rather than restored, she is a three-masted tall ship with 28 hand-set sails and 69 staterooms for up to 136 guests, roughly half of which carry balconies or opening windows. That combination is rare. No other sailing ship on our supplier list makes its case in a single sentence the way she does.
The client match is specific and strong: couples drawn to sailing but put off by large cruise ships; repeat cruisers after a different rhythm; experiential travellers who value 136 guests over 3,000.
Winter Caribbean and Central America sailings are the window to act on. The booking window with Exsus is open now.

item.title: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi has been on the radar of agents interested in Southeast Asia's long-haul luxury market. This month, ten UK agents from our network visited on a fam trip with Wide Eyed Tours and Travel, and the detail that defines this property is worth knowing.
item.description:
Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi has been on the radar of agents interested in Southeast Asia's long-haul luxury market. This month, ten UK agents from our network visited on a fam trip with Wide Eyed Tours and Travel, and the detail that defines this property is worth knowing.
Open since 1901, the Heritage Wing carries three Legendary Suites named after Graham Greene, Somerset Maugham and Charlie Chaplin. Below the swimming pool sits a 40-square-metre wartime bunker, rediscovered in 2011, restored in 2012, and the recipient of a 2013 UNESCO Award for Cultural Heritage. Daily hard-hat tours run complimentary.
For agents handling culture-led clients, history travellers and honeymoon enquiries, this is a property where the story does the selling. Worth having in the kit.

item.title: St Michael's Mount appeared on Condé Nast Traveller's Postcard of the Day this week… our first UK pick for Destination of the Week, and it belongs in the slot.
item.description:
St Michael's Mount appeared on Condé Nast Traveller's Postcard of the Day this week… our first UK pick for Destination of the Week, and it belongs in the slot.
The Mount is internationally significant, twinned with Mont-Saint-Michel in Normandy and sitting on Britain's own coastline. For agents building Cornwall itineraries, it is an anchor with genuine depth.
No entry tickets are required before 30 April 2026 (outside Easter), under-fives are admitted free, and Afternoon Tea bookings include complimentary castle admission. Garden terraces open 1 May to 4 September 2026.
The agent opportunity is in the reframe. St Michael's Mount is not a domestic fallback. It is an internationally recognised landmark, and agents who know the tide times and best visiting windows will be better placed to sell it that way.

item.title: Explora I opened sales this week for the Formula 1 Grand Prix de Monaco 2027 -- the only ship allowed to dock in Port Hercule.
item.description:
Explora Journeys opened sales this week for Explora I's stay at the Formula 1 Grand Prix de Monaco 2027, and it is the kind of booking worth having on the radar early.
Explora I is the only cruise ship permitted to dock in Port Hercule during race weekend, which removes the accommodation problem that usually puts clients off attending Monaco Grand Prix in person. Three suite tiers are on sale now, from full Paddock Club™ hospitality to a quieter suite-only stay with the race unfolding from the water, and early trade signals suggest suites are moving quickly.
Within JLT, we are flagging this as a genuinely unrepeatable option for clients who have already done the big-ticket cruise or the private villa holiday and are looking for the next thing that cannot simply be booked anywhere else.
Worth raising with the right client this week.

item.title: Qwabi Private Game Reserve solves the two objections that usually stop a first safari booking: malaria and shared reserves.
item.description:
Titan Travel has a flash sale running on Qwabi Private Game Reserve, and it is worth flagging to agents whose clients have talked about safari without ever booking one.
Qwabi sits in a malaria-free part of South Africa's Waterberg Biosphere and operates as a private reserve rather than a shared one, which removes the two most common objections before they come up in conversation. The ten-day tour includes 13 game drives, a rhino monitoring experience, and a night of bush dining under the stars, with 21 meals and a nationwide chauffeur service built into the price.
Within JLT, we see this as one of the easier safari conversions on the books right now, for exactly the reason the flash sale exists.
Worth raising with the right client this week.

item.title: The Dolomites are having an autumn moment, and it's not the ski-season conversation your clients expect.
item.description:
The Dolomites are worth a fresh look this autumn, and it is not the pitch most clients expect from that region.
Trentino's tourism board is currently promoting hiking, trekking, lake holidays and wellness stays ahead of the winter ski season, backed by Trentodoc sparkling wine and a genuine cluster of Michelin-starred restaurants. It gives agents a food-and-wine-led alternative to the standard Dolomites ski pitch, and it does not depend on any single hotel or supplier to sell.
Within JLT, we see this as a strong option for clients weighing up an autumn Italy trip who have not settled on a region yet.
Worth raising with the right client this week.

item.title: AE Expeditions has opened its Glaciers & Fjords of Southern Patagonia sailing for 28 March 2027, an 11-day expedition aboard the Douglas Mawson, the line's newest ship.
item.description:
AE Expeditions has opened its Glaciers & Fjords of Southern Patagonia sailing for 28 March 2027, an 11-day expedition aboard the Douglas Mawson, the line's newest ship.
The one-way route runs from Ushuaia to Punta Arenas via Glacier Alley and the Pío XI Glacier, one of the few glaciers in the world still advancing. Zodiac cruises, guided hikes through sub-Antarctic forest, and a Magellanic penguin colony more than 4,000 strong are included, alongside all meals, house spirits and shore excursions.
AE Expeditions is B Corp Certified with 35 years of small-ship operating history. To mark the anniversary, the line is offering 25% off plus a £2,600 per person air credit for a limited time.
Worth flagging to clients considering Patagonia or Antarctica-adjacent travel.

item.title: Skiworld has added Chalet Patrique to its La Plagne programme for the 26/27 season, and the size is the story. Three en-suite bedrooms, sleeping six, with a private sauna reserved for the booking party alone.
item.description:
Skiworld has added Chalet Patrique to its La Plagne programme for the 26/27 season, and the size is the story. Three en-suite bedrooms, sleeping six, with a private sauna reserved for the booking party alone.
The chalet sits in Plagne Soleil, 75 metres from the piste and 500 metres from the nearest lift, with access to the Dou du Praz blue run. Catering runs from a welcome vin chaud through to three-course dinners with hand-picked wines.
Standard packages range from £876 to £2,299 per person for seven nights, and January 2027 bookings include a complimentary lift pass.
A clean answer for the small-group or family enquiry that a large chalet hotel would overwhelm.

item.title: Porto is worth having on the radar for clients who've already done Lisbon and want something quieter with the same easy flight access.
item.description:
Porto is worth having on the radar for clients who've already done Lisbon and want something quieter with the same easy flight access.
Portugal's second city has picked up two significant awards in as many years: City of the Year from Food and Travel magazine in 2023, and World's Leading Seaside Metropolitan Destination at the 2024 World Travel Awards. The UNESCO-listed Ribeira waterfront, historic port wine cellars across the river in Vila Nova de Gaia, and Livraria Lello, one of the world's most beautiful bookshops, give agents a genuine itinerary to build around rather than a loose city-break brief.
The strongest client fit is couples, food-and-wine travellers, and culture and literature fans.

item.title: Marella Cruises has confirmed its summer 2027 programme, and one itinerary is on our radar this week.
item.description:
Marella Cruises has confirmed its summer 2027 programme, and one itinerary is on our radar this week.
Discovery 2, Marella's adults-only ship homeported in Dubrovnik, will make a first-ever call at Sarandë in Albania as part of the new Ionian Shores sailing. It pairs that debut port with Syracuse in Sicily, departing from 6 May 2027, from £1,930pp.
This matters for agents working the couples and adults-only market. A brand-new port gives agents a reason to contact repeat clients that is not discount-led. For clients who have done the standard Adriatic circuit and want somewhere new on the map, this is a specific and bookable answer.
Marella's Cruise Month runs through to 30 September 2026. The 2027 programme is open now. Flag this one for any clients in the couples or honeymooner bracket.

item.title: ATELIER Playa Mujeres is one of those properties that repositions a destination in a client's mind. Adults-only, all-suite, and built around contemporary Mexican art, it sits on the Caribbean coast north of Cancún and addresses a gap in the market: couples who want design-led, food-led calm rather than the busy resort strip.
item.description:
ATELIER Playa Mujeres is one of those properties that repositions a destination in a client's mind. Adults-only, all-suite, and built around contemporary Mexican art, it sits on the Caribbean coast north of Cancún and addresses a gap in the market: couples who want design-led, food-led calm rather than the busy resort strip.
Within JLT, agents access rates through Stuba.com, with full margin control. The product gives a honeymoon or milestone anniversary booking real substance: Michelin-listed fine dining by Edgar Núñez, an award-winning 3,600m² spa across three storeys, and 593 suites across a Dine-Around concept with 20-plus restaurants and bars.
There is a live offer worth noting: book before 6 October 2026 for savings up to 45% on selected stays through to June 2027. Agents with anniversary and honeymoon clients in the pipeline should have this on their radar now.

item.title: Two of the world's great bucket-list destinations in one nine-night itinerary. That is what Wonky Sheep Travel has put together for May 2027, and we think it is worth agents knowing about now.
item.description:
Two of the world's great bucket-list destinations in one nine-night itinerary. That is what Wonky Sheep Travel has put together for May 2027, and we think it is worth agents knowing about now.
The Jordan-to-Egypt route takes in Petra, the Pyramids of Giza, Wadi Rum, Little Petra, the Dead Sea, Saqqara, and the new Grand Egyptian Museum. All flights, internal transfers, accommodation, and most meals are included in the package. Priced from £2,439pp based on two sharing.
The escorted small-group format removes much of the logistical complexity across two countries and a border crossing. For milestone and culture-led clients, this is a strong fit.
Balance is due 5 February 2027. The full spotlight is on the blog.

item.title: Silversea has built a named Special Destination Experience at Canouan into select 2026/27 Caribbean sailings. The booking window for combined savings on those sailings closes 8 September.
item.description:
Silversea has built a named Special Destination Experience at Canouan into select 2026/27 Caribbean sailings. The booking window for combined savings on those sailings closes 8 September.
Within JLT, we are drawing luxury specialists' attention to this itinerary because the shore day is structured in a way that is genuinely sellable: a Carnaval parade on arrival, beach time on some of the most protected water in the Grenadines, then an evening soirée with barbecue, cocktails and live music. That is a day a client can picture before they have said yes.
The ship reinforces the pitch. All-suite, ocean-facing, crew-to-guest ratio close to one-to-one, and the S.A.L.T. destination-dining programme tying the itinerary to the plate.
For agents with luxury Caribbean enquiries on their desk this week: treat 8 September as the prompt to open a booking conversation with the right clients now.

item.title: Within JLT, we spotlight supplier news when there is a practical booking angle attached. Ikos Dassia on Corfu has one right now.
item.description:
Within JLT, we spotlight supplier news when there is a practical booking angle attached. Ikos Dassia on Corfu has one right now.
A reduced minimum-stay requirement across late-summer 2026 dates came through the trade before it went public. Confirming the exact dates with the supplier this week puts agents ahead of the public listing.
The property covers three distinct client types: high-value families, celebration couples, and couples after grown-up dining and beach service. Nine on-site restaurants with Michelin-starred menus, the Dine Out concept with complimentary access to local Corfiot tavernas, Ofsted-standard childcare for UK families, and the Ikos Spa by Anne Semonin Paris included in the stay rather than charged as an add-on.
For agents with a Corfu enquiry already in the inbox, this is the week to act on it.

item.title: Costa Rica sits high on the destination shortlist for nature-luxury travel, and this week's supplier material from Exsus Travel gives agents the specifics to act on it.
item.description:
Costa Rica sits high on the destination shortlist for nature-luxury travel, and this week's supplier material from Exsus Travel gives agents the specifics to act on it.
The itinerary pairs Arenal and Monteverde across eight nights, priced from £5,675pp, with a named lodge at each stage. Nayara Gardens in Arenal for volcano-view luxury; Monteverde Lodge & Gardens for cloud-forest immersion. The transfer between them, a 4WD descent to Lake Arenal followed by a 30-minute boat crossing, is a practical selling detail worth knowing.
Within JLT, we track supplier material that arrives with enough specificity to move a conversation forward. This one does. Couples wanting adventure and wildlife without giving up comfort represent an established brief in Central America travel, and this itinerary answers it with product you can name.
Keep Costa Rica on the enquiry shortlist and anchor at £5,675pp.
